# 🔍 SEO Optimizer · www.example.com
**50/100** 🟠 · Crawlable homepage, but the pricing page is hidden from search and one page is empty without JavaScript.

## ⚡ This week's changes
| # | Page | Change | Impact | Effort | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /app | Server-render the app page so crawlers can read it | 🔴 high | project | Eng |
| 2 | /pricing | Remove noindex and write a descriptive title | 🔴 high | quick fix | Web |
| 3 | / | Shorten the title and add a meta description | 🔴 high | quick fix | Web |

## 📊 Scorecard
Indexability | ░░░░░░░░░░ 0/10
Titles & meta descriptions | ██░░░░░░░░ 2/10
Headings & content | ██░░░░░░░░ 2/10
Structured data & social | ███████░░░ 7/10
Internal links & images | ████████░░ 8/10
Technical | ████████░░ 8/10

## 🧰 Copy-ready fixes
### 1. /app — Server-render the app page so crawlers can read it
The page has 0 words in its raw HTML; most crawlers other than Google see it empty.

### 2. /pricing — Remove noindex and write a descriptive title
The page is in the sitemap but says "noindex", and its 7-character title "Pricing" does not say what is priced.
```
robots meta: noindex → remove
title (7 → 57): Invoice Software Pricing for Agencies — Example Invoicing
description (85 → 129): Plans for agencies of every size, from one person to fifty, billed monthly or yearly. See what each plan includes and pick yours.
```

### 3. / — Shorten the title and add a meta description
The homepage title is 83 characters, so search results cut it off, and the page has no meta description.
```
title (83 → 49): Invoice Software for Agencies — Example Invoicing
description (0 → 129): Invoices for agencies that bill by the hour and by the project. Send them, track them and get paid faster with Example Invoicing.
```

## ❔ What this brief could not check
- Pages were read as raw HTML without running JavaScript.
- Rankings, clicks and search volume need Search Console or an SEO data provider.

Every change is a draft: check the facts before you publish.

findings.title: Pages show no text without JavaScript
findings.fix: Server-render or pre-render the main content so crawlers that do not run JavaScript can read it.

findings.title: Pages tell search engines not to index them
findings.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should rank, or drop them from the sitemap if it is intended.

findings.title: Pages have no meta description
findings.fix: Write a 120-155 character description per page that answers what it offers and who it is for.

findings.title: Several pages share the same title
findings.fix: Write a distinct title for each page.

findings.title: Pages return an error
findings.fix: Fix or redirect these URLs, and remove dead ones from the sitemap.

findings.title: Pages have no H1 heading
findings.fix: Add one H1 per page that states the page's topic in plain words.

findings.title: JSON-LD blocks are not valid JSON
findings.fix: Fix the JSON syntax; search engines ignore a block they cannot parse.

findings.title: Sitemap lists pages that robots.txt blocks
findings.fix: Unblock them in robots.txt or remove them from the sitemap.

findings.title: No page targets "time tracking" in its title or H1
findings.evidence: None of the 6 audited pages has "time tracking" in its title or H1.
findings.fix: Pick the page that best answers "time tracking" and put the phrase in its title and H1.

findings.title: http:// does not redirect to https://
findings.evidence: https://www.example.com/ answered without redirecting to https.
findings.fix: Redirect all http traffic to https with a 301.

findings.title: Titles are too short to say what the page is about
findings.fix: Expand to 30-60 characters with the page's topic and the brand.

findings.title: Pages no other audited page links to
findings.fix: Link to them from related pages with descriptive anchor text.

findings.title: Pages have under 300 words of content
findings.fix: Add the specifics a searcher needs (what it is, who it is for, how it works, proof, FAQ).

findings.title: Titles are cut off in search results (over 60 characters)
findings.fix: Shorten to 60 characters or fewer, keeping the main topic first.

findings.title: Pages lack Open Graph title or image
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description and og:image so shared links show a proper card.

findings.title: Images have no alt text
findings.fix: Describe each meaningful image in its alt attribute.

findings.title: Pages have no canonical tag
findings.fix: Add a self-referencing canonical link to each page template.

findings.title: Pages have more than one H1
findings.fix: Keep one H1 and turn the others into H2s.

audit.sentence: On-page SEO 50/100 across 7 pages: 2 critical, 8 high, 4 medium, 4 low.
unknowns: Pages were read as raw HTML without running JavaScript, as most crawlers other than Google see them.
Rankings, clicks and search volume are not part of this audit: they need Search Console or an SEO data provider.

findings.title: Real visitors get a slow experience (Chrome UX Report)
findings.evidence: Chrome users on the whole site, last 28 days, 75th percentile: LCP 4.3 s (poor), INP 240 ms (needs improvement), CLS 0.08 (good); overall SLOW.
findings.fix: Fix the lab findings for the pages with the most traffic first; field data catches up over 28 days.

findings.title: The layout shifts while the page loads (Cumulative Layout Shift)
findings.fix: Reserve space for images, embeds and banners (width and height, or aspect-ratio) and never insert content above what is already shown.

findings.title: The main content loads slowly (Largest Contentful Paint)
findings.fix: Make the largest element (usually the hero image or headline) load first: preload it, compress it, and cut render-blocking CSS and JavaScript.

findings.title: Lighthouse performance score is under 50
findings.fix: Work through the slow-loading findings above, starting with the largest savings.

findings.title: Images are larger than they need to be
findings.fix: Serve images as WebP or AVIF at the size they are shown, and lazy-load those below the fold.

findings.title: CSS and JavaScript delay the first paint
findings.fix: Inline the critical CSS, and load the rest of the CSS and scripts with defer or async.

findings.title: The server takes over 600 ms to send the page
findings.fix: Cache the HTML at a CDN, or speed up the server work behind these pages.

findings.title: JavaScript blocks the page from responding (Total Blocking Time)
findings.fix: Split, defer or remove JavaScript that runs on load, third-party scripts first.

findings.title: Pages load JavaScript they do not use
findings.fix: Remove unused libraries and split the bundle so each page loads only its own code.

speed.sentence: Mobile performance 69/100 across 3 pages: LCP 4.6 s on /. Real users: slow.
unknowns: Lab data is one simulated Lighthouse run per page on a throttled mid-range phone on a slow 4G connection; scores can move 5-10 points between runs.
Interaction to Next Paint needs real users; in the lab, Total Blocking Time stands in for it.
